text:
lina: Heads-up — terraform apply for iam/service-roles planned in 30m (release/v1.8). preflight + release notes sync needed.
maya: I ran `terraform plan` against staging, saw a drift for `aws_iam_role.app-service`. small diff, likely from manual tweak last week.
ajay: deploy-bot: preflight checks: modules ok, plan runs: PASSED. module infra/iam from v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 (breaking changes flagged).
maya: can we pin the module to v2.3.1 for this rollout? v2.4.0 has the new assume_role lifecycle change that could affect cross-account binds.
zach: agree pinning until we validate the assume_role behavior in a canary. we should avoid a global apply that touches bindings.
ajay: suggestion: 1) pin module to 2.3.1 in release branch, 2) apply to us-west-2 canary org only, 3) verify logs & service access for 15m, 4) then global if green.
ops-oncall: @ops-oncall notified. i'll watch IAM audit logs and policy simulator during canary window.
maya: plan snippet:
```
- aws_iam_role.app-service
    tags.%: "-1"
+ aws_iam_role.app-service
    lifecycle.prevent_destroy: "true"
```
maya: that lifecycle change is from the newer module; pin will remove the lifecycle addition.
lina: decision: pin to v2.3.1 in release branch and run a canary apply to us-west-2 only. update release notes: "Pinned iam module due to assume_role lifecycle change; canary rollout planned." i'll add a short blurb.
ajay: deploy-bot: starting staged apply (canary) in 5m -> targeting org-id: 111111, region: us-west-2, batch: 1/10. monitor channel #eng-oncall and this thread.
zach: monitoring prometheus auth_failures and AWS CloudTrail. verbose logging on for the canary.
ops-oncall: saw one denied call at +3m, investigating; looks like a stale role ARN in one service account. rolling back that specific change now.
maya: extracted offending resource and added a quick patch to keep old ARN mapping. pushing patch to branch.
ajay: deploy-bot: canary apply partially failed -> auto-rollback triggered for batch 1. rollback complete.
lina: thanks team. we'll keep the branch pinned and add a follow-up: full audit of module v2.4.0 changes + migration guide before next release. i'll update the release notes and notify product.
maya: filing a short postmortem note in release docs: "Canary caught assume_role lifecycle regressions; rollback performed; module pinned." :memo:
lina: ok closing thread for now — reopen if any residual alerts. :thumbsup:
